facts.fact: Mauritania's decentralisation directorate says the municipal collector application, in use since 2020, now benefits about 30 municipalities and will be extended to the rest.
The Interior Ministry's decentralisation directorate organised the workshop validating the user guide of the El Mouhassil municipal collector system.
The Mudun project, supported by the World Bank, has funded training, equipment, technical support and collectors' bonuses for El Mouhassil in municipalities.

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Directorate General of Decentralisation
